name: ActionButton
author: Raj Soni

sections.description:
ActionButton is a lightweight, responsive sticky footer button plugin for WordPress. It helps you drive user attention toward a “Register Now,” “Subscribe,” or any call-to-action with smooth animations and customizable styling.

🎯 How It Works
– Configure your button from the admin panel.
– Copy the shortcode [action_button id="0"].
– Paste it on any page where you want the button to appear.

🛠️ Live Updates
Edit text, link, font color, or gradient — all changes reflect instantly on pages using the shortcode.

✨ Core Features
– Add a single sticky footer button (free version)
– Customize:
– Button Text
– Link URL
– Font Color
– Gradient Background Colors
– Fully mobile responsive
– Compatible with all major browsers
– Animated gradient and zoom text effect
– Clean admin interface
– Developer-friendly shortcode

🚀 Coming Soon in ActionButton Pro
– Add multiple sticky buttons
– Show buttons globally without shortcodes
– Device-specific visibility controls
– More animations, placement options, and design presets
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/actionbutton or install it via the Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate it through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Dashboard → ActionButton to create your button.
  4. Use the shortcode [action_button id="0"] on any page where you want the button to appear.
sections.faq:
Will the button show on every page?

No. The button will only appear where you place the shortcode.

Can I add more than one button?

The free version supports a single button. ActionButton Pro will allow unlimited buttons.

Is the button mobile responsive?

Yes, it is fully responsive on phones, tablets, and desktops.

Will I need to re-insert the shortcode after editing the button?

No. Edits in the admin panel automatically apply to all places where the shortcode is used.
